meta.title: "Add 'override' modifier" quick fix for abstract method produces incorrect modifier order
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#45274 (Fix position of keyword in "Add 'override' modifier" code fix), 5a2153a729, 2021-08-03; git tag --contains: first in v4.4-rc / v4.4.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.3.5 (2021-06-30) and typescript@4.4.2 (2021-08-26), both behind typescript-language-server@0.7.1, started with the pinned tsserver.js (--tsserver-path); the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. Deviation from the wrapper rule: the release current at 4.4.2 (0.6.1) starts but never reports the TypeScript version it runs (no 'Using Typescript version' log), so the build check cannot pass; 0.7.1 (2021-11-10) is the earliest wrapper that reports it and is the wrapper of the 4.4.4 -> 4.5.2 pilot case.
meta.notes: Wrong modifier order ('override abstract') is reported by the checker (TS1029), not by the parser, hence edit_leaves_diagnostic.

settings_note: tsconfig.json carries the option of the issue's playground links (noImplicitOverride=true).

files.note: noImplicitOverride=true, the only option the issue's playground links set

repro.steps: Open index.ts with noImplicitOverride on: the abstract foo of Child is reported for a missing override modifier. Apply the quick fix "Add 'override' modifier". Reported: the result is 'override abstract foo(): void;', which raises "'abstract' modifier must precede 'override' modifier" (TS1029); expected 'abstract override foo(): void;'. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted diagnostic nor a new error.
